name: pm-skills
description: 32 domain-specific skills for product managers — covering discovery, strategy, execution, analytics, stakeholder communication, design collaboration, and career tools.

plugins.name: pm-analytics
plugins.description: Skills for product analytics: A/B tests, data analysis, experiment design, health checks, retention, and SQL.

plugins.name: pm-design
plugins.description: Skills for design collaboration: UX critique and design handoff briefs.

plugins.name: pm-discovery
plugins.description: Skills for product discovery: user interviews, research synthesis, competitive intelligence, and signal aggregation.

plugins.name: pm-execution
plugins.description: Skills for shipping: PRDs, release notes, feature prioritisation, experiment design, A/B test planning, launch readiness, and resolving ambiguity.

plugins.name: pm-stakeholders
plugins.description: Skills for stakeholder communication: executive updates, stakeholder briefs, influence mapping, performance reviews, and weekly reviews.

plugins.name: pm-strategy
plugins.description: Skills for product strategy: AI product canvas, OKRs, pricing, strategy critique, roadmap narrative, and strategic storytelling.

plugins.name: pm-toolkit
plugins.description: Miscellaneous PM career and utility skills: job applications, CV tailoring, and ATS optimisation.
